with flow/zip/feedback/paired as BotRecoveryPair
with machine/usb/control/request as UsbControlRequest
with machine/usb/control/result as UsbControlResult

# First BOT profile only: interface 0, bulk IN 0x81, bulk OUT 0x02.
# Invoke only after the previous transfer has acknowledged quiescence.
# Recovery grants no block request, write authority or command replay.
type BotRecoveryRequest =
    ready UsbControlRequest
    | refused
type BotRecoveryOutcome =
    recovered
    | refused

plot bot-recovery-start (
    interface: U64...| <= 4096B >> next: BotRecoveryRequest...| <= 4096B
) = (. == 0 ? ready({ setup: 0x000000000000ff21, output: [] }) : refused(empty))

# Only exact successful zero-data acknowledgments advance the sequence.
plot bot-recovery-after-reset (
    result: UsbControlResult...| <= 4096B >> next: BotRecoveryRequest...| <= 4096B
) = (. is completed ? (.completed.transferred == 0 && !.completed.short && sequence/length(.completed.input) == 0 ? ready({ setup: 0x0000008100000102, output: [] }) : refused(empty)) : refused(empty))

plot bot-recovery-after-clear-in (
    result: UsbControlResult...| <= 4096B >> next: BotRecoveryRequest...| <= 4096B
) = (. is completed ? (.completed.transferred == 0 && !.completed.short && sequence/length(.completed.input) == 0 ? ready({ setup: 0x0000000200000102, output: [] }) : refused(empty)) : refused(empty))

plot bot-recovery-after-clear-out (
    result: UsbControlResult...| <= 4096B >> outcome: BotRecoveryOutcome...| <= 4096B
) = (. is completed ? (.completed.transferred == 0 && !.completed.short && sequence/length(.completed.input) == 0 ? recovered(empty) : refused(empty)) : refused(empty))

# One recovery per explicitly supplied seed. The caller must retain the same
# selected attachment and wait for original transfer quiescence before seeding.
type BotRecoveryState = {
    phase: U64
    failed: Boolean
    terminal: Boolean
}
type BotRecoveryRoute =
    running BotRecoveryState
    | stopped BotRecoveryState
plot bot-recovery-seed (
    interface: U64...| <= 4096B >> state: BotRecoveryState...| <= 4096B
) = ({ phase: 0, failed: . != 0, terminal: . != 0 })
plot bot-recovery-route (
    state: BotRecoveryState...| <= 4096B >> route: BotRecoveryRoute...| <= 4096B
) = (.terminal || .phase >= 3 ? stopped(.) : running(.))
plot bot-recovery-request (
    state: BotRecoveryState...| <= 4096B >> request: UsbControlRequest...| <= 4096B
) = ({ setup: .phase == 0 ? 0x000000000000ff21 : (.phase == 1 ? 0x0000008100000102 : 0x0000000200000102), output: [] })
plot bot-recovery-advance (
    pair: BotRecoveryPair...| >> state: BotRecoveryState...| <= 4096B
) = ({ phase: .0.phase + 1, failed: .1 is completed ? (.1.completed.transferred != 0 || .1.completed.short || sequence/length(.1.completed.input) != 0) : true, terminal: .0.phase >= 2 || (.1 is completed ? (.1.completed.transferred != 0 || .1.completed.short || sequence/length(.1.completed.input) != 0) : true) })
plot bot-recovery-outcome (
    state: BotRecoveryState...| <= 4096B >> result: BotRecoveryOutcome...| <= 4096B
) = (.failed ? refused(empty) : recovered(empty))
plot bot-reset-recovery (
    interface: U64...| <= 4096B >> result: BotRecoveryOutcome...|
) {
    cell: state/seeded/flow/until
    route: bot-recovery-route()
    join: flow/zip/feedback
    control: machine/usb/control
    interface >> bot-recovery-seed() >> cell.seed
    cell.current >> route
    route >> select(BotRecoveryRoute.running, unmatched=drop) >> join.left
    route >> select(BotRecoveryRoute.running, unmatched=drop) >> bot-recovery-request() >> control.request
    control.result >> join.right
    join.paired >> bot-recovery-advance() >> cell.next
    route >> select(BotRecoveryRoute.stopped, unmatched=drop) >> bot-recovery-outcome() >> result
}
